unitTitle: Present Perfect Simple - Past Simple vs Present Perfect Simple - Present Perfect Continuous

pairsWith.noteUz: Present Perfect Simple, have gone/been, for/since/just/yet/already mashqlari.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 7-UNIT MAShQLAR (36-bet, PDF 35). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '7'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Present Perfect Simple':
1) 'Match Column A to Column B, as in the example.' A: 1 Tom hasn't spoken 2 Have you ever been 3 Sam has called me 4 How long have you 5 I haven't seen my grandmother 6 Jason has already finished 7 We are hungry because we haven't 8 Molly is an excellent student and has never. B: a five times this morning. b since I was 12 years old. c his homework. d to Lee for three years. e eaten dinner yet. f lived in Chicago? g failed an exam. h to Singapore? Namuna: 1 → d.
2) 'Make short exchanges using the prompts below, as in the example.' 1 The dog is barking. (you/take/for a walk) A: The dog is barking. Have you taken him for a walk? B: No, I haven't. 2 The food is burning. (you/turn off/oven) 3 The flowers are dry. (Ann/water/them) 4 The kitchen floor is dirty. (Scott/mop/it) 5 The baby is crying. (Carol/feed/her) 6 There isn't any milk. (Tim and Chris/do/shopping) 7 Mary is on the phone. (you/tell her/good news) 8 The fridge isn't working. (Sam/call/repairman) 9 Our guests are here. (Bill/set/the table)

O'NG USTUN - 'Have gone to - Have been to':
3) 'Fill in the gaps with have/has been or have/has gone.' 1 "Where are Mary and Steve?" "They ...... to Cornwall for the weekend." 2 Tom and Ken ...... to the football match. 3 "Are you going to Vienna for your holiday?" "No, I ...... already ...... to Vienna." 4 The Smiths ...... to many European countries. 5 Your sister ...... to the theatre tonight. 6 Dad ...... to the supermarket. The fridge is full. 7 I have heard that London is a pretty city but I ...... never ...... there. 8 Marie ...... to the shops. She should be home by 9:00.
'For - Since - Just - Yet - Already':
4) 'Fill in the gaps with since or for, as in the example.' 1 for four years 2 ...... we had lunch 3 ...... one hour 4 ...... I left school 5 ...... two months 6 ...... Sunday morning 7 ...... three weeks 8 ...... this afternoon 9 ...... five minutes 10 ...... she was a baby
5) 'Fill in the gaps with since or for.' 1 I haven't been to the city ...... October. 2 Mary has been a nurse ...... seven years. 3 We have been happier ...... we moved to the country. 4 I haven't seen you ...... ages! 5 It has been extremely hot ...... more than five days. 6 I haven't been to this park ...... I was a child.
6) 'Underline the correct word, as in the example.' 1 Has Carl painted the kitchen just/yet? 2 I have been waiting for the bus since/for thirty minutes. 3 Pete has already/since cleaned his room. 4 We have yet/just finished eating our dinner.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '36'.

exercises.instructionEn: Match Column A to Column B, as in the example. Example: 1 Tom hasn't spoken → d to Lee for three years.
exercises.instructionUz: A ustunni B ustunga moslang, namunadagidek. Namuna: 1 Tom hasn't spoken → d to Lee for three years.
exercises.explanationUz:
GAPNI TUGATISh - MA'NO va ShAKLGA
  QARAB.

  1 hasn't spoken → d to Lee for
    three years
  2 Have you ever been → h to
    Singapore?
  3 has called me → a five times
    this morning
  4 How long have you → f lived in
    Chicago?
  5 haven't seen my grandmother →
    b since I was 12
  6 has already finished → c his
    homework
  7 haven't → e eaten dinner yet
  8 has never → g failed an exam


⚠ 'TO FAIL AN EXAM':

  = imtihondan yiqilmoq.

pairs.right: d to Lee for three years.
b since I was 12 years old.

pairs.left: 7 We are hungry because we haven't
8 Molly is an excellent student and has never
pairs.leftUz: Molli a'lo talaba va hech qachon

(Ann/water/them) 4 Oshxona poli kir. (Scott/mop/it) 5 Chaqaloq yig'layapti. (Carol/feed/her) 6 Sut yo'q. (Tim and Chris/do/shopping) 7 Meri telefonda. (you/tell her/good news) 8 Muzlatgich ishlamayapti. (Sam/call/repairman) 9 Mehmonlar keldi. (Bill/set/the table)
exercises.explanationUz:
HOZIRGI HOLAT → 'QILDINGMI?'
  SAVOLI.

  A: HOLAT. Have/Has + kim + V3
     ...?
  B: No, ... haven't/hasn't.

  Hamma holat muammo → javob 'No'
  (qilinmagan).

  V3: taken, turned off, watered,
  mopped, fed, done, told, called,
  set


⚠ 'TO SET THE TABLE':

  = dasturxon yozmoq.


⚠ 'TO MOP':

  = (polni) yuvmoq.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 A: The dog is barking. Have you taken him for a walk? B: No, I haven't.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 A: It vovullayapti. Uni sayrga olib chiqdingmi? B: Yo'q.
modelAnswers: 1 A: The dog is barking. Have you taken him for a walk? B: No, I haven't.
2 A: The food is burning. Have you turned off the oven? B: No, I haven't.
3 A: The flowers are dry. Has Ann watered them? B: No, she hasn't.
4 A: The kitchen floor is dirty. Has Scott mopped it? B: No, he hasn't.
5 A: The baby is crying. Has Carol fed her? B: No, she hasn't.
6 A: There isn't any milk. Have Tim and Chris done the shopping? B: No, they haven't.
7 A: Mary is on the phone. Have you told her the good news? B: No, I haven't.
8 A: The fridge isn't working. Has Sam called the repairman? B: No, he hasn't.
9 A: Our guests are here. Has Bill set the table? B: No, he hasn't.
modelAnswersUz: 1 It vovullayapti. Uni sayrga olib chiqdingmi? - Yo'q. (NAMUNA)
3 Gullar qurigan. Enn ularni sug'ordimi? - Yo'q.
4 Oshxona poli kir. Skott uni yuvdimi? - Yo'q.
5 Chaqaloq yig'layapti. Kerol uni ovqatlantirdimi? - Yo'q. (feed → fed)
6 Sut yo'q. Tim va Kris xarid qilishdimi? - Yo'q. (do → done)
7 Meri telefonda. Unga xushxabarni aytdingmi? - Yo'q. (tell → told)
8 Muzlatgich ishlamayapti. Sem ustani chaqirdimi? - Yo'q.
9 Mehmonlar keldi. Bill dasturxon yozdimi? - Yo'q. (set → set)

sections.title: Have gone to - Have been to
sections.titleUz: Have gone to - Have been to

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with have/has been or have/has gone.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni have/has been yoki have/has gone bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
GONE (ketgan, hali o'sha yerda)
  yoki BEEN (borib kelgan)?

  1 have GONE to Cornwall (hozir
    o'sha yerda - 'Where are
    they?')
  2 have GONE to the match
  3 have already BEEN to Vienna
    (borganman, qaytganman)
  4 have BEEN to many countries
    (tajriba)
  5 has GONE to the theatre
    (hozir teatrda)
  6 has BEEN to the supermarket
    (qaytgan - muzlatgich to'la)
  7 have never BEEN there (tajriba)
  8 has GONE to the shops (hali
    qaytmagan - 'should be home by
    9')


⚠ 'CORNWALL':

  = Kornuoll (Angliya janubi-
  g'arbi).

items.textEn: "Where are Mary and Steve?" "They ___ to Cornwall for the weekend."
Tom and Ken ___ to the football match.
"Are you going to Vienna for your holiday?" "No, I ___ already ___ to Vienna."
The Smiths ___ to many European countries.
Your sister ___ to the theatre tonight.
Dad ___ to the supermarket. The fridge is full.
I have heard that London is a pretty city but I ___ never ___ there.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Hech qachon bo'lmaganman → have never been.

items.textEn: Marie ___ to the shops. She should be home by 9:00.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with since or for, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni since yoki for bilan to'ldiring, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
FOR + MUDDAT / SINCE + NUQTA.

  FOR: four years, one hour, two
    months, three weeks, five
    minutes (qancha vaqt?)
  SINCE: we had lunch, I left
    school, Sunday morning, this
    afternoon, she was a baby
    (qachondan?)

  ⚠ 'since' dan keyin gap ham
  kelishi mumkin: since I left
  school.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with since or for.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni since yoki for bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
GAPLARDA FOR / SINCE.

  1 SINCE October (nuqta)
  2 FOR seven years (muddat)
  3 SINCE we moved (nuqta)
  4 FOR ages (muddat - 'ages' =
    juda uzoq vaqt)
  5 FOR more than five days
    (muddat)
  6 SINCE I was a child (nuqta)


⚠ 'FOR AGES':

  = ancha vaqtdan beri, asrlardan
  beri (mubolag'a).

Mary has been a nurse ___ seven years.
We have been happier ___ we moved to the country.
I haven't seen you ___ ages!
It has been extremely hot ___ more than five days.
I haven't been to this park ___ I was a child.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
JUST / YET / ALREADY / FOR /
  SINCE.

  1 painted the kitchen YET? (savol
    oxirida)
  2 waiting FOR thirty minutes
    (muddat)
  3 has ALREADY cleaned (tasdiq,
    have va V3 orasida)
  4 have JUST finished (endigina)

items.textEn: Has Carl painted the kitchen just/yet?
I have been waiting for the bus since/for thirty minutes.
items.uz: Men avtobusni o'ttiz daqiqadan beri kutyapman.

items.textEn: Pete has already/since cleaned his room.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Tasdiq, have va V3 orasida → already.

items.textEn: We have yet/just finished eating our dinner.
items.uz: Biz endigina kechki ovqatni yeb bo'ldik.

patterns.formula: HOLAT. Have / Has + KIM + V3 ...? — No, ... haven't / hasn't.
patterns.exampleEn: The flowers are dry. Has Ann watered them? — No, she hasn't.
patterns.exampleUz: Gullar qurigan. Enn ularni sug'ordimi? — Yo'q.

patterns.formula: KIM + has gone to + JOY (hali u yerda) / KIM + has been to + JOY (qaytgan)
patterns.exampleEn: Dad has been to the supermarket. The fridge is full. Marie has gone to the shops.
patterns.exampleUz: Dadam supermarketga borib keldi. Muzlatgich to'la. Mari do'konga ketgan.

patterns.formula: KIM + has / have + V3 + for + MUDDAT / since + NUQTA
patterns.exampleEn: Mary has been a nurse for seven years. I haven't been to the city since October.
patterns.exampleUz: Meri yetti yildan beri hamshira. Oktabrdan beri shaharga bormadim.
